text: きょうも　たたかって　うんだめしと　いくか！

structure.jp: うんだめしと　いくか！
structure.en: shall I go try my luck!

patterns.name: 〜といく
patterns.span: うんだめしと　いく
patterns.explanation: A thing followed by と いく is a breezy way to say 'let's go for it' or 'let's have a go at it'. うんだめしと　いく = 'go for a test of luck'.

patterns.name: 〜か (self-talk)
patterns.explanation: か after a plain verb, said to yourself, means 'well, shall I do it then'. いくか = 'shall I get going'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins one action to the next, like 'and'. たたかって = 'battle and'.
